controls: simulateDashboardCommand clones the snapshot before domain execution and derives before/after/diff exclusively from authorized page projection.
Both preview and apply route to the same canonical DashboardBudget, DashboardPeople, DashboardOperations or DashboardPortfolio domain.

Apply recomputes the current projection and physical visible-record/page incarnation binding; actor and command are separately bound by digest. Changed authority or visible material rejects before domain execution.
Domain CAS conflict values are filtered through visibleStored; raw hidden record fields are not sent to the caller.
Generated IDs are a host responsibility; the paired mutation-scope/prepared path supplies reserved IDs and checks exact consumption.
Footprint is derived from actual before/after domain data, including cascades and generated records, instead of trusting submitted field names.
Collection rows require nonempty string or safe integer unique IDs; malformed and unknown shapes fail closed.
Year and month of each logical row constrain the authorized effect period; cross-year or cross-month replacement cannot be represented as an unchanged period.
Creates and existing-target mutations have separate grants, and every changed field and period must be covered.

Scope construction replays the exact preview digest and checks unique reserved IDs with exact consumption. prepared.ts repeats live scoped identity/projection checks, the domain apply, footprint digest and grant coverage before commit.
budgetYtd, deviations, budgetCurrentMonth and revenueByYear are normalized into isolated logical records with authoritative key-derived IDs and periods.
budgetYtd kind and annual owner key remain distinct; string owner IDs with colons or hyphens retain their identity through the documented key format.
Record value fields cannot override the key-derived id/kind/year/month/owner identity.
Malformed keys, month outside 1..12, scalar group values and nonfinite numeric year-map values return undefined instead of silently excluding rows.
Target surface, record type/id, nonempty fields and period are validated; unknown types return unavailable.
Record families route to the canonical authorized page; talent private-field requests use Talent Review rather than a public headcount projection.

The issuer delegates to createDashboardRecordEvidenceHost and createDashboardRecordSourceIssuer, whose real request authentication, current roleMap, actor and exact field/period checks repeat before egress.
The historical D06 issue was observer reissue under a different page, not evidence that the canonical initial issuer should be broadened; do not replace exact source matching with identity guesses.
